title: settling-monotonicity
description: The condition on a settle-indexed family of predication valuations over a settling bound that each valuation is below the next in the knowledge order, so information only grows and conflicts accumulate as top rather than trivializing.

family.description: the family v = (v_tau) for tau < lambda of predication valuations indexed by settle stages

settling-bound.description: the ordinal bound lambda indexing the settle stages

monotone.description: for all sigma <= tau < lambda and every predicate p, v_sigma(p) <=_k v_tau(p) pointwise in the predication fiber algebra A_p, where <=_k is the knowledge order
